Team —

Quick debrief on Maya (Staff SWE candidate). We need to lock a hiring recommendation today if possible. Please: 1) drop your numeric score into the attached scorecard by 12:00pm PT, 2) flag any critical concerns inline in the doc or reply here.

I attached the consolidated scorecard (Maya_Velasquez_scorecard.xlsx) and a short debrief doc (link below) with interview highlights. At a glance there is a split on system design (Connor: lower) vs. execution/ownership (others: higher).

If the gap persists, proposing a 15-minute sync at 3:30pm PT to do a quick tiebreak and agree next steps (offer vs. no hire). Availability: 3:00–4:00pm PT works for me; if you can’t make it, please state explicit vote in the scorecard.

Marissa,

Score entered: 6/10 (system design concerns, particularly tradeoffs for long-lived services and multi-tenant routing). Happy to elaborate on the sync — I left detailed notes in the system-design tab.

Two quick points: 1) I saw limited depth on capacity planning under high QPS scenarios (asked twice), 2) behavioral answers on delegation were solid. If the rest of the panel lands 8+, I'm OK supporting an offer but would like either a focused follow-up or a stronger hiring rubric on design risks.

Connor

Thanks for the fast turnaround. Quick summary and next steps:

- Scores submitted: 6, 8, 9, (Laura left vote: 8). Consolidated mean = 7.75.
- Action: short 15m sync at 3:30pm PT to confirm nuance on system design risk and whether we require a targeted follow-up question or proceed to offer.
- Outcome: We reached consensus to extend an offer pending comp approval from ELT. Mina to draft a short follow-up tech question (if needed) and Connor to sign off on the wording.
- Marissa will draft offer timeline and confirm with Sanjay (candidate rep).

If anyone changes their vote after the sync, reply-all with explicit reason — we want the record. Otherwise I’ll mark Greenhouse GH-54231 as "Offer: recommended" and start paperwork.

Thanks — great cross-functional alignment.
Marissa
